title: DVID-style IoT device: anonymous MQTT broker (no auth)

target.hint: An MQTT broker on 1883. Try subscribing/publishing with no credentials.

objective: An IoT device's MQTT broker is network-exposed. Determine whether it allows anonymous connections. Prove you can subscribe to device topics (and that publish is open too), name the weakness with a CWE, and give the fix. Use an MQTT client (mosquitto_sub / paho / nc) via shell.
